payload.title: Design system: cross-platform component parity, token validation, runtime context switching
payload.description:
From internal/specs/2026-05-09-frick-design-language-framework-design.md. Web has ~45 components (packages/design-web); iOS (packages/design-swift) and Android are partial/stubbed.

- Complete the Phase 1 component set to parity across web (React/CSS), iOS (SwiftUI), Android (Compose): foundation, layout, controls, feedback, identity, communication, data display, date/time, charts (spec:151-244, 315-316).
- Harden token validation (pnpm design:check): off-scale spacing/radius, invalid density, circular aliases, missing icon maps, contrast failures, raw literals; deterministic generated artifacts that fail builds when stale (spec:247-288).
- Runtime design context switching — mode/density/brand/icon-pack changeable without restart (spec:84-121, 314).

Size: L.
